target.title: fix #99601: fix(opencode-go): expose DeepSeek V4 max thinking levels
target.body:
## Summary

- Problem: OpenCode Go DeepSeek V4 models did not expose `/think xhigh` or `/think max` because their runtime and manifest model rows lacked `thinkingLevelMap` metadata.
- Solution: Add the missing DeepSeek V4 thinking-level map to the two OpenCode Go catalog rows while keeping the existing shared DeepSeek V4 stream wrapper unchanged.
- What changed: Updated `extensions/opencode-go/provider-catalog.ts`, `extensions/opencode-go/openclaw.plugin.json`, and focused opencode-go regression coverage in `extensions/opencode-go/index.test.ts`.
- What was not changed: No auth, endpoint, dependency, transport, live discovery, or stream-wrapper code changed.
- Fixes #99601

## What Problem This Solves

OpenCode Go DeepSeek V4 models support the max reasoning effort path, and OpenClaw's shared DeepSeek V4 wrapper already sends provider `reasoning_effort: "max"` when the selected thinking level is `xhigh` or `max`. The provider metadata was missing the explicit `thinkingLevelMap` entries required for OpenClaw to advertise and preserve those two levels for `opencode-go/deepseek-v4-pro` and `opencode-go/deepseek-v4-flash`.

## User Impact

Users selecting `/think xhigh` or `/think max` for the two OpenCode Go DeepSeek V4 models can now keep that selected level through OpenClaw model capability resolution. Before this patch, OpenClaw filtered those levels out locally before the request reached the provider wrapper, so the selection was effectively limited to the largest lower exposed level.

## Origin / follow-up

N/A — independent root cause for #99601. Related open PRs are handled in the competition analysis below rather than treated as a merged follow-up anchor.

## Competition / linked PR analysis

- **Linked PR(s):** #99637 is an open draft for #99601. #99618 covers the same root area through a broader stream-wrapper rewrite against a related issue.
- **Gap in linked PR(s):** #99637 is still draft and did not include the maintainer-ready proof/body required by this flow at the time this PR was prepared. #99618 was reviewed as needing proof and compatibility fixes because it changed existing `high` behavior and duplicated the shared DeepSeek V4 wrapper.
- **Why this patch is better/canonical:** This patch keeps the production fix metadata-only, leaves `extensions/opencode-go/stream.ts` unchanged, preserves the existing `high -> high` and `xhigh|max -> max` shared-wrapper contract, and adds direct opencode-go coverage for the catalog and wrapper boundaries.
- **Local real behavior proof advantage:** The proof runs the production opencode-go plugin registration path at this PR's HEAD, resolves both affected models, verifies `clampThinkingLevel()` preserves `high`, `xhigh`, and `max`, and checks that runtime catalog, static discovery, and manifest metadata all expose the same map. It does not rely on mock responses or fixture model rows.

## Real behavior proof

- **Behavior or issue addressed:** OpenCode Go DeepSeek V4 runtime model resolution now exposes `xhigh` and `max` thinking levels instead of letting OpenClaw clamp those selections away before request construction.
- **Real environment tested:** Local OpenClaw worktree at HEAD `d13f33be6f1a9ac0e02b2d079479762b0d44ab7f`, using the production opencode-go plugin entrypoint, production plugin-test registration runtime, production `clampThinkingLevel`, production static provider discovery, and the bundled plugin manifest.
- **Exact steps or command run after this patch:**

```bash
pnpm -C "$TASK_WORKTREE" exec tsx -e '<register the production opencode-go plugin, resolve deepseek-v4-pro/deepseek-v4-flash, run clampThinkingLevel for high/xhigh/max, inspect static provider discovery, and inspect openclaw.plugin.json>'
```

- **Evidence after fix:**

```text
Evidence file: /media/vdb/code/ai/aispace/openclaw-issue-99601-evidence/opencode-go-runtime-proof.log

HEAD=d13f33be6f1a9ac0e02b2d079479762b0d44ab7f
runtime opencode-go/deepseek-v4-pro reasoning=true api=openai-completions
runtime deepseek-v4-pro thinkingLevelMap={"off":null,"minimal":"high","low":"high","medium":"high","high":"high","xhigh":"max","max":"max"}
runtime deepseek-v4-pro clamp(high)=high
runtime deepseek-v4-pro clamp(xhigh)=xhigh
runtime deepseek-v4-pro clamp(max)=max
runtime opencode-go/deepseek-v4-flash reasoning=true api=openai-completions
runtime deepseek-v4-flash thinkingLevelMap={"off":null,"minimal":"high","low":"high","medium":"high","high":"high","xhigh":"max","max":"max"}
runtime deepseek-v4-flash clamp(high)=high
runtime deepseek-v4-flash clamp(xhigh)=xhigh
runtime deepseek-v4-flash clamp(max)=max
staticCatalog opencode-go/deepseek-v4-pro thinkingLevelMap={"off":null,"minimal":"high","low":"high","medium":"high","high":"high","xhigh":"max","max":"max"}
staticCatalog opencode-go/deepseek-v4-flash thinkingLevelMap={"off":null,"minimal":"high","low":"high","medium":"high","high":"high","xhigh":"max","max":"max"}
manifest deepseek-v4-pro thinkingLevelMap={"off":null,"minimal":"high","low":"high","medium":"high","high":"high","xhigh":"max","max":"max"}
manifest deepseek-v4-flash thinkingLevelMap={"off":null,"minimal":"high","low":"high","medium":"high","high":"high","xhigh":"max","max":"max"}
```

- **Observed result after fix:** Both affected OpenCode Go DeepSeek V4 models resolve through the production plugin runtime with `xhigh` and `max` present in `thinkingLevelMap`, and `clampThinkingLevel()` preserves `high`, `xhigh`, and `max`. Static discovery and manifest metadata carry the same map.
- **What was not tested:** I did not run an authenticated OpenCode Go generation request or force a live provider completion, because this bug is in OpenClaw's local model metadata and thinking-level capability resolution before any authenticated provider request is made. The regression tests cover wrapper payload behavior separately, but this real behavior proof does not rely on those tests or on mock evidence.
- **Why it matters / User impact:** The affected users can now select the provider's max reasoning effort for OpenCode Go DeepSeek V4 without OpenClaw silently dropping the requested level before request construction.
- **Fix classification:** Root cause fix.

## Review findings addressed

N/A — this is a new PR, not an existing PR repair round. The related #99618 review findings were avoided by keeping the shared DeepSeek V4 wrapper as the single source of truth and by preserving `high` below `max`.

## Regression Test Plan

- **Target test file:** `extensions/opencode-go/index.test.ts`
- **Scenario locked in:** Runtime model catalog rows, manifest rows, static discovery rows, `clampThinkingLevel()` for `high`/`xhigh`/`max`, DeepSeek V4 wrapper mapping for `high`/`xhigh`/`max`, and unrelated OpenCode Go model isolation.
- **Why this is the smallest reliable guardrail:** The bug lives at the opencode-go provider metadata boundary, and this file already owns opencode-go plugin registration, discovery, manifest, and wrapper behavior tests.

```bash
pnpm -C "$TASK_WORKTREE" exec vitest run extensions/opencode-go/index.test.ts
```

```text
Test Files  1 passed (1)
Tests  16 passed (16)
```

## Merge risk

- **Risk labels considered:** compatibility.
- **Risk explanation:** The change affects provider capability metadata for two existing OpenCode Go DeepSeek V4 models. It intentionally does not change auth, base URLs, request dispatch, live discovery networking, or stream-wrapper code.
- **Why acceptable:** The diff is limited to two catalog rows plus matching manifest metadata. Existing lower-level behavior is preserved: `high` remains `high`, while only `xhigh` and `max` use the existing max-effort wrapper path. Focused tests verify both affected models and an unrelated OpenCode Go model.

## What was not changed

- Public API / schema / protocol / defaults: unchanged.
- Channel/provider/session/security behavior outside the fixed path: unchanged; only the two OpenCode Go DeepSeek V4 model metadata rows were updated.
- Unrelated cleanup, docs, formatting, lockfiles: none.

## Root Cause

- **Root cause:** OpenClaw's thinking-level utility only advertises `xhigh` and `max` when the selected model has explicit `thinkingLevelMap` entries for those levels; the OpenCode Go DeepSeek V4 model rows did not include them.
- **Why this is root-cause fix:** Adding the map at the provider model metadata source lets the existing model capability and clamp logic preserve the requested level before downstream transport/wrapper code runs.
- **Maintainer-ready confidence:** High.
- **Patch quality notes:** The production patch is metadata-only and keeps the existing shared DeepSeek V4 wrapper as the single source of truth.
- **Architecture / source-of-truth check:** `extensions/opencode-go/provider-catalog.ts` owns runtime OpenCode Go model metadata, and `extensions/opencode-go/openclaw.plugin.json` owns the bundled manifest projection. This changes the provider metadata source before downstream capability projection, session validation, and request wrapper behavior.
